metadata.title: Pseudo-Einstein Structures on Links of Isolated Singularities
metadata.abstract: We study Jack Lee's conjecture that, for a compact strictly pseudoconvex CR manifold $M$, the condition $c_1(T^{1,0}M)=0$ in $H^2(M,\mathbb{R})$ implies the existence of a pseudo-Einstein structure. For links of isolated singularities, we construct counterexamples in every odd dimension at least three, with $c_1(T^{1,0}M)=0$ in $H^2(M,\mathbb{Z})$ and $b_1(M)=0$. For isolated algebraic singularities of log canonical type and complex dimension at least three, we prove that the real Chern class condition is equivalent to $\mathbb{Q}$-Cartierness of the canonical divisor, log canonicity, and the existence of a pseudo-Einstein structure. Finally, we construct a Du Bois threefold singularity whose link satisfies the real Chern class condition but admits no pseudo-Einstein structure. The initial versions of the proofs were generated with AI assistance and were subsequently revised and verified by the authors.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 针对严格伪凸 CR 奇点链环，检验实第一 Chern 类消失是否推出伪 Einstein 结构。
techniques: 典范除子的 Q-Cartier 性
对数典范与 Du Bois 奇点
analysis.breakthrough: 奇点链环在所有至少三的奇维都有整 Chern 类消失、b₁=0 的反例。对数典范型下用解消的支撑上同调与解析下降把实 Chern 类消失推进为 Q-Cartier；Du Bois 三维例的对偶复形环路仍能保留非酉粘合障碍。
analysis.limitations: 等价定理需要复维至少三的正规孤立对数典范型奇点。Du Bois 三维例主张实 Chern 类消失；更早的一般维数反例则有整 Chern 类消失。补读主结果，未独立验证整篇证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: ChatGPT GPT-6 Astra 给出三维反例线索，参与高维反例与第4、5节发展。作者还披露 AI 协助初版证明、修订第2、3节及准备说明，OpenAI Prism 用于稿件准备和编辑；作者逐项审查并修正。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.04851v1 · PDF 第1页摘要、第3页研究过程及 AI 使用声明
